about_the_game:
Amentia is an action rpg where you construct your deck of magic cards to survive hordes of enemies and defeat challenging bosses bringers of chaos.

Build your deck : 

While surviving assaults from strange creatures you will collect gems and cards filled with magic! Use theses cards wisely to upgrade your character’s skills and gain more power. 

All cards unlocked during the game will be available to craft in your collection at the beginning of each run, giving you better chances to survive. 

Be aware : the magic trapped within the cards has a cost, you’ll learn it the hard way!

What you’ll find in Amentia :

  • 3 maps with 5 levels of difficulty.

  • 3 characters, each with unique cards and playstyle.

  • Challenging boss fights.

  • A real deckbuilding experience where cards matter.

  • Over 60 actives and passives cards.

  • RNG : your cards are shuffled and drawn in different order.

  • All hand-drawn visuals and animations.

 

Choose your gameplay :

You have the possibility to choose when you play your cards in order to unleash powerful combos or to have a more casual experience by using the « automatic mode ».
